parsed.rationale: Although `StreamingService.name` (Metadata package) and `MusicServiceIdentifier.displayName` (MusicShareKit package) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.875), they are computed properties on two distinct domain types — `StreamingService` and `MusicServiceIdentifier` — that model related but separate concepts. The differing names (`name` vs `displayName`) and their residence in separate packages with no indicated shared ancestor suggest the similarity is a natural consequence of both being simple string-returning display-label properties rather than a true duplication worth collapsing. Extracting a shared protocol or default implementation would couple two packages that currently have no stated dependency relationship, introducing architectural overhead that outweighs the marginal gain from deduplicating a trivially small computed property body.
